says: A person activates a memory reader on Claude Code 2.1.278 with zero business Instructions selected: preparation.compose writes a personal preparation of nothing, and session.routing.activate answers with that session activated, no projections, the runtime-owned compact memory usage contract and the guide it points at by path and digest, the always surface unchanged and the native instruction files preserved. delivery.observe sees that activation and no unit delivered. A second preparation over the same selection is composed and never activated; observing it finds nothing delivered, so selection alone reaches no session. In the activated conversation the journal-mode conflict (WAL in the repository, a rollback journal in the person's own decisions) goes back through memory.use.prepare: the question is sealed and pending, asked on the qualified conversation route, answered by the person with WAL for this use only (ask_each_use), and that use is admitted. A child agent then needs the same decision. Observing the child finds nothing delivered, since the parent's receipt proves nothing about it, and the child's own use, prepared for its own link, gets its own pending question rather than the parent's answer. Asking on the child's link is recorded with no channel and the owner invents no answer; asked in the person's conversation instead, the person answers, the owner records the verified answer for the child's question, and the child's own use is admitted. The WAL body is then delivered to the child and the receipt names exactly that body; after the conversation is compacted, the rehydrated recipient is sent the actual body again and its receipt names exactly what arrived. Every receipt describes only the managed route it was made on.
